sourceAnchors: src/app/api/settings/database/route.js (GET exportDb / POST importDb, password or CLI-token auth)
src/lib/db/index.js exportDb() / importDb() (payload shape, wipe semantics, transactionality)
src/lib/db/repos/settingsRepo.js exportSettings() (settings payload is the raw settings object)
src/lib/db/backup.js (pre-schema-change safety backup; KEEP_BACKUPS=3; requestDetails excluded)
src/lib/db/migrate.js (pre-schema backup only when !fresh && pending schema change)

importSemantics.wipe: All exportable tables are deleted inside a single transaction before re-insertion; payload keys that are absent are still wiped (missing-key replacement).
importSemantics.transactionality: The whole wipe-and-reinsert runs in one transaction; any failure rolls everything back.
importSemantics.validation: The payload must be a JSON object (not array/null); each domain is validated before any write.
importSemantics.confirmation: Import is destructive and partial; it requires explicit typed confirmation.
importSemantics.distinctFromDRBackup: This is the manual configuration transfer contract (DECISIONS #378); disaster-recovery backup/restore is a separate contract (DECISIONS #201-204).

carriedDomains: proxyPools -> gorouter_proxy_pools (pool rows only; members reference non-transferable gorouter_proxy_configs)
rejectedDomainsOnImport: apiKeys: local keys are hash-only and user-scoped; no raw key material exists to carry
combos: member routing lists reference non-transferable account identities
localReconciliation.credentialHandling: Fixture credential fields are placeholder values (sanitized). The export carries stored provider fields including api_key_value per the original contract; the resulting file must be treated as sensitive.
localReconciliation.pricingKeyOwnership: The settings repository never reads or writes the pricing:overrides key; the pricing repository owns it.
